period: FY2015–24 independent district financial audits; FY2025 checked for follow-up and no repeat of 2024

current_year_findings.title: Finding - Year End Closing
current_year_findings.description: Cash and revenue were $3 million low after a late grant posting. A $1 million allowance on $4.6 million of student receivables should have been $2.5 million using district policy. A General Fund interfund receivable of $825,116 had no matching insurance-fund entry. These are different account adjustments.

current_year_findings.title: Finding - Capital Assets
current_year_findings.description: Historic capital records included approximately $5.5 million of unexplained negative net balances. The district had no detailed support from before 2001 and removed no equipment or vehicle disposals in the audit year. The finding questioned no costs.

followingReport.title: Finding Preparation of Schedule of Federal Awards

current_year_findings.description: Federal/state grant receivables and deferred revenue were about $700,000 high and two partly federal grants appeared as wholly state-funded. This same amount also appears in 2015-001. Count it once.

current_year_findings.title: Finding - GANN Limit Calculation
current_year_findings.description: The unrevised carryforward understated the base limit by $25,720,287 and the adjusted ceiling by $23,907,019. These are successive calculations on the same form. No limit was exceeded and no costs were questioned.

current_year_findings.title: Finding - Salaries of Classroom Instructors
current_year_findings.description: The instructional payroll classification was corrected. The final schedule on PDF page 76 excludes $1,227,885 from current expenses of education. The adjusted ratio was $84,618,755 / $168,381,672 = 50.25%, above the 50% minimum. The threshold uses the post-exclusion denominator.

scope: Counting unique identifiers assigned in each current-year schedule. Prior-year recitals retained separately. Sources in source-manifest.json.
title: City College annual district audit findings and corrective-action follow-up
notes: Count each current-year finding once, then link its independently published follow-up. Comparative references to a prior year do not add new findings.

FY2015–24 includes 33 current-year identifiers. The original seven-report screen had 36 identifiers, including six from FY2014 recovered from prior-year schedules. Thirty identifiers overlap. The full current-year review adds the three FY2023 findings.

FY2022 and FY2024 reported no current findings. FY2025 also reported no current findings and explicitly confirmed FY2024 had none. The financial and federal schedules in the FY2024 PDF have stale June 2022 heading dates; the audit opinion and the FY2025 follow-up identify the reporting year.
A follow-up status of implemented records the corrective action. It is a separate question whether a grantor ordered repayment, the college recovered a load-bank balance, or cash changed hands.
